title: Good Lattice Quotients at Depth Zero
body_html:
Good Lattice Quotients at Depth Zero

For a vertex \(x\) represented by a good lattice \(L\), the two residual spaces are \[ \ell=L/L^\#p_D,\qquad \ell^\#=L^\#/L. \] They carry induced finite-field hermitian forms, and \[ G_x/G_{x,0+}\simeq U(\ell)\times U(\ell^\#). \] The Witt classes of \(\ell\) and \(\ell^\#\) depend only on the Witt class of \(V\), not on the chosen good lattice.
